system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The planner agent inspects the toolbox and loads each tool card as defined in §2.2.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts include loaded tool-card metadata and evolving context; the prompt code was not in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: The system is aimed at reasoning QA, not repositories. The context is the query plus an image path.

observation_format.evidence_quote: obtaining a result rt. This may include tool outputs, logs, or error messages.
observation_format.note: Structured tool results are stored in context. The format sent to the LLM is not shown.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: creates a low-level command ot in the form of an executable Python script, which calls the tool dt with necessary inputs

tool_count.note: The toolset is chosen per task via enabled_tools. The base toolset is only Generalist_Solution_Generator.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The toolbox also includes image perception tools such as Image_Captioner, web search APIs like Google_Search, a code generator Python_Code_Generator

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: adding a tool requires only lightweight natural-language metadata and a few demonstration commands

protocol_standardization.note: MCP support is only a commented-out TODO.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the planner agent formulates a high-level, tentative plan for tool usage based on its initialization.
loop_primitives.note: The planner makes a high-level plan, then runs an action/execute/verify loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the high-level plan summarizes the query objective, analyzes the required skills, identifies relevant tools
planning_granularity.note: The plan is free text stored in context. There is no structured plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A separate executor agent then converts this action into an executable command, runs the tool, and updates the context with the results.
multi_agent_topology.note: The paper calls it multi-agent: planner and executor are LLM roles in a fixed sequence.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: A separate executor agent then converts this action into an executable command

short_term_state.evidence_quote: which is stored structurally in the context

self_verification.evidence_quote: After each command is executed, a context verifier checks whether the problem can be solved given the current context.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: until it finds a complete solution or reaches inference limits (e.g., time or steps)
termination_condition.note: The verifier outputs STOP. A time limit is also mentioned.

timeouts.evidence_quote: a maximum reasoning budget of 10 steps, and a time budget of 300 seconds
timeouts.note: This is the experimental setup; its default in the code is unconfirmed.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: a command executor runs the generated command ot in a Python environment
execution_isolation.note: The paper does not say whether this runs in-process or in a subprocess. There is no container evidence.

tracing.evidence_quote: The trajectory preserves a clear history of the actions taken, the code produced, and the results obtained.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: # Run inference from clevr-math using Octotools with an optimized toolset

target_domain.evidence_quote: agentic framework designed to tackle complex reasoning across diverse domains
target_domain.note: Complex reasoning QA does not map cleanly onto the allowed values.

open_source.note: The LICENSE file was not provided; this is based on the README badge.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Added support for LiteLLM LLM. Now you can use any LiteLLM-supported models.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Released Python package on PyPI at [pypi.org/project/octotoolkit]
primary_artifact.note: The repo has code postdating the paper (e.g., Ollama/LiteLLM support).

first_release_date.note: Tag dates are not in the evidence. The PyPI release was 2025-04-19 and the arXiv preprint 2025-02-16.

pinned_version.note: Pinned to a main-branch commit rather than a tag. Only the short hash is in evidence, and there is no tag. The locator line is nominal because this comes from the evidence header.

stars.note: Star count comes from the evidence bundle header at ref fddbc9d0d85e. The gh api date-stamp is not available.
